name: Piedmont Natural Gas Sutton Pipeline
researcher_notes: No existing row matches: the roster has no Piedmont or Sutton line, and North Carolina rows are only Atlantic Coast, Buncombe County, T-030, MVP Southgate, Transco and East Tennessee projects. A Power Engineering item from 31 May 2013 says Piedmont Natural Gas completed the Sutton Pipeline Project: 120 miles of 20-inch and 8 miles of 30-inch transmission pipe, plus about 25,000 horsepower of added compression, to serve the 625 MW Sutton plant in North Carolina. Total length is 128 miles (120 plus 8), well above the 25 km threshold. Completion is stated; the June 2013 service start comes from the consolidator and a Pipeliner item, which loaded but did not state the sizes in text the verifier could read. An engineering contractor page (smeinc.com) names Hamlet as a start point and was the only source for it. Hamlet start and Sutton plant end are not confirmed in one document, so endpoints are medium. Intrastate, regulated by the North Carolina Utilities Commission, so FERC silence is expected. Capacity not found. Piedmont is now part of Duke Energy (since 2016); the Parent was not staged because no verified ref was found. Owner spelled as the source spells it; the ownership team spelling with legal form (Piedmont Natural Gas Co Inc) should be confirmed. Route not researched; no GIS source checked, so RouteType should be unavailable until a route is found. Single validated source for most fields.
